item.tib: dag snang ye shes gter mdzod bon sde las sku gsum zhing sgrub khams gsum yongs grol gyi sku gsum 'khor chen bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu'i smon lam thugs rjes khams gsum rang grol bzhugs
item.coloph: zhes sku gsum zhing sgrab 'di'ang shar rong gnas 'brel skabs brag steng rgyal sar bsam lhun khang du lus nang bcas pa'i dus dag snang dang gzhung cha lag bcas bka' gtad thob pas/ rje sa dbang nyi ma dbang ldan sogs rgyal blon dang / gong ma shes rab ye shes sogs dang khro chen rgyal po'i bdag yum/ nang so rin po che slob rigs bla sprul du mas phab dgos yang yang dang*/ nyi dbon thub ston sogs phyis su theg mchog mdzod kyi rgyud 'dzin brag steng rgyal sras/ dbal khyung mchog sprul/ dbra sras mchog sprul/ rgyal bzang tshe dbang mgon po/ khyung po khu dbon/ a mdo mkhan po rnams kyis dar dang shog gu gnang nas bskul ba dang / rigs ldan pad+ma dbang mo/ rang slob bstan pa dang*/ la bstan pa dar rgyas sogs khyad par nges gsang bstan pa'i rgyud 'dzin a mdo nges don mthong ba rang grol bshul ring nas dka' ba bcas byon dang / te 'di'i rgyud 'dzin gyi rten 'brel 'grigs nas bskul ba dang*/ yang ston 'khrul zhig bya bral bas rin chen maN Dal byu ru'i tshom bu gdan bcas dang*/ rdzogs chen dbang tsa ka bcas gnang nas bka' yis bskul bzhin/ bya btang sprul ming tshe dbang 'gyur med byang chub rig rtsal gling pas/ nyag stod ri sul theg mchog bstan rgyas gling du thun mtshams su chu sprul zla tshes la grub pas// dge'o//
